cues.zh: 一根原本粉白细长的“小香肠”，
cues.en: Imagine a slender, pale pink “sausage.”

cues.zh: 为什么会在十几个小时里变成暗红，
cues.en: In this case, why did it turn dark red in a matter of hours,

cues.zh: 又覆上灰黄的脓苔，甚至出现焦黑？
cues.en: then develop a grey-yellow coat and even black patches?

cues.zh: 这根“小香肠”，其实就是阑尾。
cues.en: That “sausage” is the appendix.

cues.zh: 今天沿着这本变质日记，读懂炎症保卫战。
cues.en: Follow its colour changes to see how inflammation unfolds.

cues.zh: 颜色是线索，再看阑尾壁发生了什么。
cues.en: The colours are clues to what happens inside the appendix wall.

cues.zh: 午饭后，二十八岁的小伙开始恶心、呕吐。
cues.en: After lunch, a 28-year-old man feels nauseated and vomits.

cues.zh: 最初，他只觉得肚脐周围隐隐作痛。
cues.en: At first, he feels a dull ache around his navel.

cues.zh: 这是内脏神经传来的痛，定位并不清楚。
cues.en: Pain carried by visceral nerves is hard to pinpoint.

cues.zh: 到了傍晚，疼痛从肚脐周围移向右下腹。
cues.en: By evening, the pain migrates from the navel to the lower right abdomen.

cues.zh: 炎症累及壁腹膜，疼痛一下变得好定位。
cues.en: Once the parietal peritoneum is irritated, the pain becomes localised.

cues.zh: 医生检查麦氏点，按压痛，松手时也痛。
cues.en: At McBurney's point, the clinician finds tenderness and pain on release.

cues.zh: 到了急诊，他的体温已经升到三十九点三度。
cues.en: In the emergency department, his temperature is 39.3 °C.

cues.zh: 白细胞升高，其中中性粒细胞占了大多数。
cues.en: His white blood cell count is high, with a marked neutrophil predominance.

cues.zh: 取出的阑尾肿胀发红，原本的粉白消失了。
cues.en: The removed appendix has swollen and lost its pale pink colour.

cues.zh: 暗红，来自局部血管扩张和充血。
cues.en: The dark red colour reflects dilated, congested blood vessels.

cues.zh: 再靠近一点，阑尾表面覆着一层灰黄色脓苔。
cues.en: Look closer: a grey-yellow coat covers the appendix.

cues.zh: 把阑尾剖开，可见管腔积着浑浊的黄红色脓液。
cues.en: Cutting it open reveals cloudy, yellow-red pus inside the lumen.

cues.zh: 这样的改变，常见于蜂窝织炎性阑尾炎。
cues.en: These changes are typical of phlegmonous appendicitis.

cues.zh: 显微镜下，急性期以变质和渗出为主。
cues.en: Tissue injury and exudation dominate in the acute phase.

cues.zh: 先看“变质”：管腔可因粪石等原因梗阻。
cues.en: First comes tissue injury. A faecalith can obstruct the lumen.

cues.zh: 黏膜受损，整齐的上皮出现坏死和破溃。
cues.en: The orderly mucosal lining breaks down, with necrosis and ulceration.

cues.zh: 再看“渗出”：血管扩张，腔内挤满红细胞。
cues.en: Next, exudation. Vessels dilate and fill with red blood cells.

cues.zh: 血浆成分漏进组织，纤维间拉开了距离。
cues.en: Plasma leaks into tissue, pushing its fibres apart and causing oedema.

cues.zh: 中性粒细胞从血管游出，细胞核有二到五叶。
cues.en: Neutrophils leave the vessels. Their nuclei have two to five lobes.

cues.zh: 在化脓期，它们密集挤进阑尾壁的各层。
cues.en: In the suppurative stage, they infiltrate every layer of the wall.

cues.zh: 最外面的浆膜上，纤维素交织成一张网。
cues.en: Along the outer serosa, fibrin forms a mesh.

cues.zh: 网里裹着变性坏死的中性粒细胞，也叫脓细胞。
cues.en: The mesh traps degenerating and dead neutrophils, known as pus cells.

cues.zh: 这就是纤维素性脓性渗出物，形成灰黄色脓苔。
cues.en: This fibrinopurulent exudate forms the grey-yellow coat.

cues.zh: 单纯性到化脓性、坏疽性，是经典演变路径。
cues.en: Simple, suppurative and gangrenous disease illustrate a classic sequence.

cues.zh: 这是一条典型路径，并非每个患者都必须经历。
cues.en: This is a typical progression. Each patient may follow a different course.

cues.zh: 在早期的单纯性阶段，先看黏膜和黏膜下层。
cues.en: In early simple appendicitis, look first at the mucosa and submucosa.

cues.zh: 中性粒细胞主要聚在浅层，越往深处越稀疏。
cues.en: Neutrophils cluster in the superficial layers and thin out deeper down.

cues.zh: 到了肌层，只能看到寥寥几个散在的身影。
cues.en: In the muscle layer, only a few scattered cells come into view.

cues.zh: 到灰黄的化脓期，细胞已穿过黏膜下层。
cues.en: In the grey-yellow stage, neutrophils have spread beyond the submucosa.

cues.zh: 肌束的间隙，也被密集的中性粒细胞填满。
cues.en: Dense neutrophils pack the spaces between the muscle bundles.

cues.zh: 病情继续恶化时，系膜静脉可形成血栓。
cues.en: With worsening disease, a thrombus may form in a mesoappendiceal vein.

cues.zh: 一旦血运受损，管壁就可能缺血、坏死、变黑。
cues.en: Loss of blood supply can lead to ischaemia and blackened, necrotic tissue.

cues.zh: 阑尾壁缺血坏死后变薄变脆，严重时侧壁会穿孔。
cues.en: The necrotic wall becomes thin and fragile. In severe cases its side wall can perforate.

cues.zh: 脓液顺着破口流进腹腔，可引发危及生命的腹膜炎。
cues.en: Pus can leak through the hole and cause life-threatening peritonitis.

cues.zh: 医生先看症状和查体，再结合化验判断风险。
cues.en: Symptoms and examination come first, supported by lab tests.

cues.zh: 并非人人都需要做 CT。
cues.en: Not everyone needs a CT scan.

cues.zh: 把三型影像放一起看。
cues.en: Let's look at all three patterns together.

cues.zh: 单纯性可轻度增粗，周围脂肪间隙仍可清晰。
cues.en: In simple cases, mild enlargement can coexist with clear surrounding fat.

cues.zh: 化脓性可见壁增厚强化，周围脂肪呈絮状。
cues.en: Suppuration can show wall thickening, enhancement and hazy fat stranding.

cues.zh: 管壁缺损、少强化，或见积液和气泡，要警惕坏疽穿孔。
cues.en: A wall defect or weak enhancement can signal gangrene. Fluid or gas can suggest perforation.

cues.zh: 三型征象有差异，也会重叠，分型需结合病理。
cues.en: The imaging patterns can overlap. Subtyping also relies on pathology.

cues.zh: 成人初始 CT 的敏感度中位数是百分之九十七。
cues.en: The guideline's median sensitivity for initial CT in adults was 97%.

cues.zh: 一项成人多层增强 CT 研究也超过百分之九十三。
cues.en: Sensitivity also exceeded 93% in an adult multislice contrast-enhanced CT study.

cues.zh: 外科评估有手术指征且病情允许时，
cues.en: When the surgical team confirms that early surgery is indicated and feasible,

cues.zh: 蜂窝织炎性、坏疽性阑尾炎需尽早手术切除。
cues.en: phlegmonous or gangrenous appendicitis requires early appendectomy.

cues.zh: 若有局限性脓肿，治疗方式和时机需另行评估。
cues.en: A contained abscess calls for a separate decision on treatment and timing.

cues.zh: 急性期以变质和渗出为主，增生何时更突出？
cues.en: Tissue injury and exudation dominate acutely. When does proliferation stand out?

cues.zh: 反复发作转为慢性后，纤维性增生更突出。
cues.en: Fibrosis becomes more prominent when recurrent inflammation turns chronic.

cues.zh: 阑尾壁增厚、变硬，粉红的胶原束大量堆积。
cues.en: The wall becomes thick and firm as pink collagen bundles accumulate.

cues.zh: 还可见深紫色圆核的淋巴细胞，
cues.en: You may also see lymphocytes with dark, round nuclei,

cues.zh: 以及核偏在一侧、核旁发亮的浆细胞。
cues.en: and plasma cells with off-centre nuclei and a pale zone beside them.

cues.zh: 慢性阑尾炎手术时机的核心原则是：
cues.en: The key principle for surgery in chronic appendicitis is this.

cues.zh: 一旦确诊，通常建议在症状缓解期择期切除；
cues.en: Once confirmed, elective appendectomy is usually advised when symptoms settle.

cues.zh: 若正处于急性发作期，则视情况急诊手术。
cues.en: During an acute flare, emergency surgery depends on the clinical situation.

cues.zh: 从粉白到暗红、灰黄再到焦黑，颜色在报警。
cues.en: Pale pink, dark red, grey-yellow and black tell a story of inflammation.

cues.zh: 腹痛移到右下腹，尤其还发烧、按压疼，
cues.en: If pain moves to the lower right abdomen, especially with fever or tenderness,

cues.zh: 别硬扛，也别等它自己过去。请尽快就医。
cues.en: Don't wait for it to pass. Seek medical care promptly.
